mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(b.branch_name, '전체 합계') AS branchName, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.action_type = 'IN' THEN s.amount END), 0) AS inAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.action_type = 'OUT' THEN s.amount END), 0) AS outAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.action_type = 'LOSS' THEN s.amount END), 0) AS lossAmount FROM stock_logs s JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = s.branch_id WHERE YEAR(s.action_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(s.action_date) = #{month} GROUP BY b.branch_name WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.branch_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, b.branch_name

WITH RECURSIVE months AS ( SELECT 1 AS month UNION ALL SELECT month + 1 FROM months WHERE month < #{currentMonth} ) SELECT b.branch_name AS branchName, m.month AS month, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.action_type = 'IN' THEN s.amount END), 0) AS inAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.action_type = 'LOSS' THEN s.amount END), 0) AS lossAmount FROM branches b CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN stock_logs s ON s.branch_id = b.branch_id AND YEAR(s.action_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(s.action_date) = m.month GROUP BY b.branch_name, m.month ORDER BY b.branch_name, m.month
SELECT b.branch_name AS branchName, COUNT(*) AS zeroStockCount FROM stocks st JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = st.branch_id WHERE st.book_amount = 0 GROUP BY b.branch_name ORDER BY b.branch_name

WITH ranked AS ( SELECT c.category_name AS categoryName, SUM(st.book_amount) AS quantity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(st.book_amount) DESC) AS rn FROM stocks st JOIN branches b ON b.branch_id = st.branch_id JOIN books bk ON bk.book_isbn = st.book_isbn JOIN book_categories c ON c.category_id = bk.category_id WHERE b.branch_name = #{branchName} GROUP BY c.category_name ) SELECT categoryName, quantity FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 9 UNION ALL SELECT '기타' AS categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM ranked WHERE rn > 9
